# Sleep restriction and recall

## 2 Design

Participants were randomly assigned to a full-sleep or a restricted-sleep condition for five nights; recall was tested on the sixth morning. ^s2p1

## 3 Results

Restricted sleep reduced recall by 18% on average, but the effect vanished in the subgroup that napped. ^s3p1
